title: Patch: the card sheet's statistics, the creator's script check and a finished GIF's share offer a way on after a failure

**Issue #1818 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1818: Patch: the card sheet's statistics, the creator's script check and a finished GIF's share offer a way on after a failure
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Three places still show "that failed" with no way forward, where the rest of the app already offers a Try again button. A player opening a card's Statistics block during a network blip reads "Statistics unavailable" until they close the sheet. A card creator whose one-time script check fails to load finds Save stays dead until they type a stray character. And a player whose finished GIF fails at the phone's share sheet has to re-encode the whole thing to try again. After this change each offers a retry that re-runs only the failed step.

## Why

The Try-again-on-a-dead-end pattern is established (#1706, #1766, #1783); these three surfaces predate or miss it:

- `apps/web/src/stats/CardStatsBlock.tsx:60-66` renders "Statistics unavailable" with no retry, and the load effect runs once per card (lines 25-49). Its sibling in the same sheet, `CardHistory` (`apps/web/src/patches/CardHistory.tsx:68-72`), already pairs the alert with Try again, and the `/stats` route retries too.
- `apps/web/src/creator/Creator.tsx:261-265` shows the script-check alert, but the `useScriptCheck` effect re-runs only when `source`/`check` change (deps at line 124), so a failed lazy load of the checker (`checkCustomCard` via `apps/web/src/wasm/index.ts`) leaves `scriptReady` false and Save dead until the source text changes. The creator's own card-list failure already offers Try again (lines 441-447).
- `apps/web/src/replay/ShareGif.tsx:160-166`: `send()`'s catch flips `phase` to `{ kind: "failed" }`, discarding the `{ kind: "ready", file }` state — so a share-sheet failure costs a full re-encode.

## Proposal

- `CardStatsBlock`: a Try again that re-runs the load (a reload counter in the effect's deps, as sibling blocks do).
- `Creator`: a retry on the script-check alert that re-invokes the check, clearing the dead Save without touching the source.
- `ShareGif`: keep the `ready` phase's file when share fails and offer Share again on the failure view — retry calls `send()` with the kept file, never re-encoding.

## Where it lands

`apps/web/src/stats/CardStatsBlock.tsx`, `apps/web/src/creator/Creator.tsx` + its `useScriptCheck` hook, `apps/web/src/replay/ShareGif.tsx`, and their tests. No engine or spec surface.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each of the three failure views offers a retry that runs only the failed step.
- [ ] The GIF retry does not re-encode.
- [ ] One test per surface drives failure -> retry -> success.
- [ ] Happy paths unchanged.

## Size and risks

Medium: three small surfaces, ~6-8 files. Each is a local state change; retries stay manual, so no retry loop. The rest of the app was surveyed first — every other async surface already retries or self-heals.
```
